interface.signature: def findKthNumber(n: int, k: int) -> int:

preconditions.description: n and k are positive integers where k is between 1 and n (inclusive), and n is at most 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in [findKthNumber(n, k)])
postconditions.description: The returned integer is within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: k == sum(1 for x in range(1, n + 1) if str(x) < str(findKthNumber(n, k))) + 1
postconditions.description: The returned integer is the k-th smallest integer in the lexicographical order of numbers from 1 to n.
